en.hubeali: From him, from one of his companions, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The carnelian is a safety during the journey’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from certain persons of his people in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Agate is safety on a journey.’”
